# Contest Radar

> Open crypto contests and bounties worth entering, read and ranked daily by an agent that pays for its own data on Celo.

Contest Radar watches GitHub issues, poidh bounties, and X and Reddit posts for
things you can enter for money: bounties, thread/meme/design/video contests and
hackathons. A model reads each post for prize, deadline, effort and what to
submit; plain-code scoring ranks them on payout clarity, payment rails, amount,
risk flags (scams, key requests, KYC friction), effort, deadline window and
competition.

The agent pays for its inputs itself, per request, from a USDC float on Celo:
X and Reddit searches through the buy gateway, the model call through Agent402.
Every run's receipts are published and the feed's hash is written onchain.

Live app: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/safwaankira/contest-radar
Agent discovery: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/.well-known/agent.json
ERC-8004 registration: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/agent.json

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- JSON feed: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/feed/latest.json
- CSV feed: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/feed/latest.csv
- RSS feed: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/feed/latest.xml
- Manifest: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/feed/manifest.json
- JSON Schema: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/feed/schema.json
- Paid-call ledger: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/feed/ledger.json
- Onchain anchors: https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/feed/anchors.json

## Paid endpoint (x402 on Celo)

POST https://contest-radar-celo.vercel.app/api/scan with {"keywords":"meme OR design"}.
Unpaid requests get HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header: 0.05 in USDC,
USD₮ or USA₮ on Celo mainnet (eip155:42220), exact scheme (EIP-3009). Retry
with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. You are charged only if ranked results come
back. Works with any x402 v2 client, e.g. `buy curl --max-amount 0.05 ...`.

## Local Commands

```bash
npm test
npm run shortlist -- --min-score 50 --limit 10
npm run shortlist -- --opportunity quick-win --max-effort-score 30 --limit 10
node scripts/mcp-server.mjs   # MCP stdio: search_bounties, get_bounty
```

## Review Rules

- Scores are triage signals, not payout guarantees. Read the rules at the source before doing work.
- Never paste keys, seed phrases or sign transactions because a contest asks you to; those items are scored "avoid".
